'''Marella''' is a village in [[Altara]].

When [[Egwene al'Vere]] enters ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' physically to travel to [[Salidar]], she passes through the village of Marella. She identifies the village by the name of the [[Marella Inn]].{{ref/book|6|34}}
